title: The Slow Protocol Anew
author: M. M. Reyes
blurb: Mara Sterling, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
